text: Codex Security plugin scans authorized code and confirms plausible vulnerability findings
quote: Install the Codex Security plugin to scan authorized code and confirm plausible vulnerability findings.

text: Gmail plugin lets you work with Gmail
quote: Install the Gmail plugin to work with Gmail.

text: Google Drive plugin works across Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides
quote: Install the Google Drive plugin to work across Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides.

text: Slack plugin summarizes channels and drafts replies
quote: Install the Slack plugin to summarize channels or draft replies.

text: Messages plugin reads and searches iMessage, SMS, and RCS chats on a Mac and sends messages on your behalf
quote: it can read and search iMessage, SMS, and RCS chats on your Mac and send messages on your behalf through the Messages app

text: Typing /plugins in Codex CLI opens a plugin browser for discovering plugins
quote: In Codex CLI, enter `/plugins` to open the plugin browser.

text: Public plugins are discoverable from one universal plugin directory shared by ChatGPT and Codex
quote: Both products use one universal plugin directory, so the same public plugins are discoverable from their supported surfaces.

text: A skill creator guides authoring by asking what the skill does, when it triggers, and whether it needs scripts
quote: The creator asks what the skill does, when it should trigger, and whether it should stay instruction-only or include scripts.

text: A recorder captures a demonstrated workflow and drafts a reusable skill from it
quote: The recorder captures the workflow, inspects the steps, and drafts a reusable skill from the demonstration.

text: $skill-installer installs individual curated skills by name inside Codex
quote:
Curated skills can be installed by name (defaults to `skills/.curated`):


$skill-installer gh-address-comments

text: $skill-installer can install a curated or experimental skill directly from a GitHub directory URL
quote: Or provide the GitHub directory URL: $skill-installer install https://github.com/openai/skills/tree/main/skills/.experimental/create-plan

text: Teams can check skills into a working folder so they apply only to a specific module or microservice
quote: teams can check in skills relevant to a working folder. For example, skills only relevant to a microservice or a module.

text: Codex discovers skills in .agents/skills in every directory from the current working directory up to the repo root
quote: Codex scans `.agents/skills` in every directory from your current working directory up to the repository root.

text: The built-in @plugin-creator skill scaffolds the plugin manifest and can generate a local marketplace entry for testing
quote: For the fastest setup, use the built-in `@plugin-creator` skill. It scaffolds the required `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` manifest and can also generate a local marketplace entry for testing.

text: plugin-creator creates the plugin folder and manifest and adds MCP server wiring
quote: The plugin-creator skill will create the plugin folder, create the required `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, and add MCP server wiring for the plugin.

text: The codex plugin marketplace add CLI command adds and tracks a marketplace source without editing config by hand
quote: Use `codex plugin marketplace add` to add and track a marketplace source instead of editing `config.toml` by hand.

text: Local and repo marketplaces act as sources for authoring, testing, and distributing plugins to a team
quote: Local and repo marketplaces are separate authoring, testing, and team-distribution sources, and their availability can vary by surface.

text: Install a plugin from a configured marketplace, and its bundled skills and tools are available in the next session
quote: Install a plugin from a configured marketplace, then start a new session before using its bundled skills or tools.

text: Figma plugin supports use_figma, Code to Canvas, Code Connect, and design system rules
quote: `plugins/figma` for `use_figma`, Code to Canvas, Code Connect, and design system rules

text: Codex and Figma round-trip lets you bring running interfaces into Figma, refine them, and bring changes back
quote: Use Codex and Figma to bring real, running interfaces into Figma, refine them, and bring changes back to Codex.

text: iOS apps plugin helps with SwiftUI implementation, refactors, performance, and debugging
quote: `plugins/build-ios-apps` for SwiftUI implementation, refactors, performance, and debugging

text: Web apps plugin covers deployment, UI, payments, and database workflows
quote: `plugins/build-web-apps` for deployment, UI, payments, and database workflows

text: Expo plugin supports Expo and React Native apps, SDK upgrades, EAS workflows, and Codex Run actions
quote: `plugins/expo` for Expo and React Native apps, SDK upgrades, EAS workflows, and Codex Run actions

text: Notion plugin supports planning, research, meetings, and knowledge capture
quote: `plugins/notion` for planning, research, meetings, and knowledge capture

text: Sign in with ChatGPT is available in beta for partner plugins such as Airtable, GitLab, HubSpot, Notion, Supabase, and Vercel
quote: Sign in with ChatGPT is rolling out in beta for supported plugins and partner sites, including Airtable, GitLab, HubSpot, Notion, Supabase, and Vercel.

text: Signing in with ChatGPT shares only name, email, and profile picture and doesn't grant data access or auto-approve actions
quote: Signing in shares only your name, email address, and profile picture, when available, with the partner. It doesn't grant the plugin access to your data or approve actions automatically.

text: A skill is a plain directory with a SKILL.md requiring name and description, plus optional scripts and references
quote: A skill is a directory with a `SKILL.md` file plus optional scripts and references. The `SKILL.md` file must include `name` and `description`.

text: Skills build on the open agent skills standard
quote: Skills build on the open agent skills standard.

text: Skills are loaded progressively: the name and description are read first, and the full SKILL.md is loaded when the skill is chosen
quote: ChatGPT and Codex start with each skill's name and description, then load the full `SKILL.md` instructions when they decide to use that skill.

text: The skill context budget is configurable via skills.max_context_tokens, up to 10,000 tokens
quote: Use `skills.max_context_tokens` to set a different budget, up to 10,000 tokens.

text: In Codex CLI or the IDE extension, run /skills or type $ to mention and invoke a skill
quote: In Codex CLI or the IDE extension, run `/skills` or type `$` to mention a skill.

text: Installed plugins add skills and MCP tools to new chats in ChatGPT Chat/Work and in Codex
quote: Open the Plugins tab to browse and install plugins. After installation, you can use plugins in Chat or Work in ChatGPT, or in Codex. Installed plugins can add skills and MCP tools to new chats.

text: Skills bundled in plugins work in ChatGPT on web, desktop, and mobile
quote: Skills bundled in plugins are also available in Chat and Work across ChatGPT on the web, desktop, and mobile.

text: The ChatGPT desktop app has a Skills sidebar for viewing skills created across projects
quote: In the ChatGPT desktop app, open **Skills** in the sidebar to view and explore skills created across your projects.

text: Plugins can be packaged in a portable Agent Plugins format by declaring that schema in plugin.json at the root
quote: For a portable Agent Plugins package, add `plugin.json` at the plugin root and declare the Agent Plugins schema.

text: Legacy .codex-plugin/plugin.json manifests remain supported as a compatibility fallback
quote: Existing `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` files remain supported as a compatibility fallback.

text: A plugin can contain skills, MCP servers, or both, including skills-only or remote MCP-only plugins
quote: A plugin can contain skills, MCP servers, or both. You can submit: A skills-only plugin that packages reusable workflows. A remote MCP-only plugin.

text: Plugins can include optional companion surfaces such as agents, commands, hooks, app config, and assets
quote: optional companion surfaces such as `skills/`, `.app.json`, `.mcp.json`, plugin-level `agents/`, `commands/`, `hooks.json`, `assets/`

text: Plugins use the Model Context Protocol to expose server-backed tools to ChatGPT and Codex
quote: Plugins use the [Model Context Protocol (MCP)] to expose server-backed capabilities to ChatGPT and Codex.

text: A plugin can prompt you to connect an external service before its tools become available
quote: A plugin can prompt you to connect an external service before its tools become available.

text: Skills can be packaged as plugins so other people can install them
quote: Use skills to design the workflow itself, then package it as a plugin when you want other people to install it.

text: Plugins can be submitted through a submission portal for review before public publication
quote: Use the plugin submission portal to submit a plugin for review when you're ready to publish it for public use.

text: Submission takes a ZIP package, surfaces automated findings to resolve, and lets you choose when to publish after approval
quote: Submit the package you've already built as a ZIP, resolve automated findings, and submit it for review. Once approved, you choose when to publish.

text: Submission status, review progress, and MCP setup are tracked from the Plugins page
quote: Start a submission and track publication, review progress, and MCP setup from the Plugins page.

text: Guidance is provided for migrating existing Claude Code plugins or connectors to OpenAI
quote: If you're migrating an existing Claude Code plugin or connector, first review [Submit your Claude Code plugin to OpenAI] to see what you need to change before starting the submission.

text: After publication, MCP server changes are picked up automatically and eligible updates go live once they pass automated checks
quote: After initial publication, changes to your MCP server are picked up automatically, and eligible updates go live once they pass automated checks.

text: ChatGPT implements the open MCP Apps UI standard, so a plugin UI built once runs across compatible hosts
quote: ChatGPT implements the open MCP Apps UI standard so you can build your UI once and run it across MCP Apps-compatible hosts.

text: MCP servers can implement event subscriptions and webhook delivery
quote: Implement event subscriptions and webhook delivery for your MCP server.

text: A Checkout API supports implementing checkout from optional plugin UI
quote: Checkout API reference: Implement checkout from optional plugin UI.

text: Plugins available to your account can be used in Chat or Work on mobile
quote: On mobile, you can use plugins available to your account in Chat or Work.
